name: No Man's Land: Fruit of the Earth, Part One
title: Batman: Shadow of the Bat #88
desc:
The aftermath of the "Assembly" begins to take effect in Part 1 of the 3-part "Fruit of the Earth"! Since Gotham became a No Man's Land, Poison Ivy has maintained control of Robinson Park, turning it into a botanical Eden. But now Clayface has invaded the park and threatens to destroy Ivy's paradise. And unbeknownst to either villain, Batman and Robin need to retrieve something hidden deep beneath the park that could be the key to ending Gotham's time as a "No Man's Land."

Story continues with Batman #568 - No Man's Land: Fruit of the Earth, Part Two
